verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents syncs that run on a trigger or when data changes, real-time syncing, and automated journeys built in a no-code UI. Together these cover automatic actions on data or event changes. However, the evidence never details a rule engine for defining event-based conditions that fire actions, and how journeys are triggered is not described. Missing for 10: documented event-trigger rule definition (conditions → actions), detail on journey entry triggers and available trigger types, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: A sync runs on the schedule or trigger you set, then reports the outcome of each run so you can confirm it worked.
Sync modeled data to sales, support, analytics, and internal tools on a schedule or when data changes.
Create audiences from warehouse data, build automated journeys
Sync to 300\+ destinations in real-time or on a recurring schedule.
